messages.text: Hi there - can you ship bc04 miner to NZ, with a local power supply ?
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner BC04

Yes, we ship to New Zealand. The Hammer Miner BC04 (6 TH/s, ~100W) is $239 and in stock, so it ships within about 5 business days.

It comes with the 120W power supply and a US or EU cord, not an NZ plug. A standard NZ IEC power cable or a plug adapter is all you need, same as we tell our UK buyers. NZ GST or duty at import is charged by customs on delivery, we don't collect it at checkout.

Want me to build the cart so you can see shipping?
Is the power supply compatible with Nz mains?
Handed to the team · PSU input voltage range is not in the product data and I will not guess a spec.

I don't want to guess on that one. The listing gives the PSU as 120W but doesn't state its input voltage range, so I can't confirm 230V/50Hz from here.

I've put it to JD, who handles the hardware side. The team is offline now and picks it up Monday at 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email rather than you waiting here.

What's the best email to send it to?
